remarks: Fully renovated 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartment in a two-family home in Greenwich. This bright and updated unit features a newly renovated kitchen, brand new bathroom, beautifully refinished hardwood floors, and a new heating and cooling system with central air. The apartment has been freshly painted throughout and offers a comfortable open living space. Additional highlights include an electric garage and a long driveway providing ample off-street parking. Laundry is conveniently located in the garage, and the unit offers additional storage space within the garage. Unit 1 also features two separate entrances, including direct entry from the garage. Conveniently located near Hamilton Avenue with easy access to downtown Greenwich, Metro-North, shops, and restaurants. Pets considered with fee. Landlord covers water and landscaping. Tenant responsible for other utilities. Credit and background check required. Strong credit and income verification preferred. Available for immediate occupancy.
